his_words: Astra in gpt is the final scan only till better models are available grow when needed
meaning: the seat named 'final' is driven LAST in every cycle and is handed the earlier seats' answers as data to scan; 'only till better models are available' -- python covenant_ai_consult.py --roster-final NAME moves the final scan; 'grow when needed' -- --roster-add NAME adds a seat. The labels are the app's own, as it shows them; a label it no longer shows is a skipped seat, said so.
